stories.title: Interior design trends shift toward warmth
stories.summary: Designers are moving away from cool neutrals toward layered, lived-in spaces. Laura Gerber of ODE Design says the trend focuses on authentic materials that make a home feel effortless. The industry is currently prioritising wood and organic textures to help residents feel like spending time in their rooms.

stories.title: The World’s Best Airline Spent $1.6 Billion on New Cabins. People Hate the Design - Fodors Travel Guide
Sebring Design Build wins universal design award
stories.summary: Sebring Design Build received the Best Universal Design award from Kitchen and Bath Business magazine for a primary bathroom in Franklin, Tennessee. The project reconfigured the space to improve accessibility while maintaining its original character. The firm serves clients across Williamson County and the surrounding areas.

stories.title: Artists wrap historic São Paulo building in silver
stories.summary: Artists Vhils and Marcelo Cidade have covered a historic building in São Paulo with reflective thermal sheets. Titled 2878, the installation uses silver material and cornstarch paste to alter the structure's appearance. The project aims to explore urban memory by giving the old facade a metallic finish.

stories.title: Cook Architecture recognized for historic restoration
stories.summary: Cook Architecture received a Modernism in America Award for its restoration of a 1951 Charles Goodman home. The firm focuses on residential projects that balance historic preservation with modern living requirements. The studio is currently based in Falls Church, Virginia, and maintains a portfolio of mid-century modern work.

stories.title: Theater Amsterdam updates visual identity
stories.summary: Design agency Evers and de Gier has rebranded Theater Amsterdam to emphasize its waterfront venue and stage technology. The project aims to improve the theater's digital presence to attract event planners. The agency developed the new look around the brand idea of events that cannot be ignored.

stories.title: Hershey refreshes travel retail brand identity
stories.summary: The Hershey Company has updated its travel retail portfolio with new packaging and airport activations. The company says the transformation is designed to meet the needs of global travelers and boost conversion rates. The revamped range aims to increase brand relevance through premium gifting and immersive retail experiences.

stories.title: Nike unveils 3D-printed air technology
stories.summary: Nike has introduced 3D-printed air bags for its upcoming trainers. Chief innovation officer Phil McCartney described the technology as a revolution rather than an evolution, calling it a huge stride forward. The company intends to use the platform to control cushioning and support in future footwear designs.

stories.title: Nike counts on new air technology to reverse slump
stories.summary: Nike is launching Tuned Air, a high-tech evolution of its cushioning platform, ahead of its financial results. The company has faced several years of performance missteps and expects the new technology to help pull it out of a slump. The platform will debut in a running sneaker.

stories.title: Molteni Museum hosts experimental design exhibition
stories.summary: The Molteni Museum is exhibiting Materialized: Ideas in Matter, featuring reinterpretations of iconic furniture by ten designers. The collection includes items like inflatable cushions and centipede-shaped tables. The exhibition aims to shift the museum toward a contemporary art gallery by questioning the limits of traditional product design.

stories.title: VineGarden Films splits into two brands
stories.summary: Production house VineGarden Films has rebranded its animation and learning division as ArtEquation. The move separates the company's advertising film business from its educational content work. The firm has operated as a bootstrapped business for over a decade and maintains client partnerships spanning eight years.

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million for AI sensors
stories.summary: Delhi-based Bharat Semi has raised $24 million to develop AI-enabled image sensors. The startup claims its technology can reduce system costs by 70 percent by integrating processing on a single chip. Commercial production is targeted for 2027, with design wins already secured with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon.

stories.title: Pentagram rebrands Greece’s Alpha Bank around legacy symbol - Creative Review
Creative Dive: How Mother Tongue Design Began With the Sound of Metal to Rebrand P•TAL - Branding in Asia
Bedow creates geometric identity for Inventure
stories.summary: Stockholm studio Bedow has designed a visual identity for venture capital firm Inventure. The system uses a 30-degree grid to organize corporate materials and slides. The logo features letters that open into a 60-degree wedge, while the color palette incorporates diagonal planes of red, grey, and yellow.

stories.title: FC Barcelona to refresh kit typography
stories.summary: FC Barcelona will introduce new namesets and fonts for the 27-28 season. The update continues the club's recent move toward bespoke typefaces for each kit, following a major overhaul for the 26-27 campaign. The club previously used a Gaudí-inspired look for its home jersey.

stories.title: Mother Design updates MLB brand identity
stories.summary: Mother Design has refreshed the MLB brand identity using five custom typefaces and the league's 1968 batter logo. The firm calls the approach Modernize Nostalgia, aiming to update the league's visual past for a new generation. The project supports the league's new platform, Baseball Is Something Else.

stories.title: Klim Type Foundry releases neo-grotesque font
stories.summary: Klim Type Foundry has released Die Grotesk, a variable typeface designed for optical scale. Designer Kris Sowersby developed the font to address the legacy of Helvetica. The foundry's design essay compares the x-height ratios of various typefaces to highlight the technical differences in the new release.

stories.title: Maybelline updates tagline in new brand identity
stories.summary: Maybelline is evolving its 1991 tagline, “Maybe she’s born with it,” from a question into a statement. Global brand president Sandrine Jolly says the company is using the recognizable line as a foundation for the future. The brand remains the world’s number one makeup seller, according to the company.

stories.title: Kuda brand identity is a masterclass in more life by Barkas
stories.summary: Design firm Barkas has built a new identity for the Nigerian bank Kuda, centered on the slogan “More Life.” The system features a stacked wordmark and deep purple palette. The bank says it aims to challenge the friction of traditional banking for a generation seeking financial growth.

stories.title: Pentagram designs rhythmic identity for St. Louis Symphony Orchestra
stories.summary: Pentagram has created a new monogram for the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra, featuring looping ribbons that echo the architecture of Powell Hall. The design follows the ensemble's 146th season and the expansion of the Jack C. Taylor Music Center. Timing shaped the brief.

stories.title: KFH-Bahrain unveils KFH Private brand identity
stories.summary: Kuwait Finance House-Bahrain has launched “KFH Private” to represent its wealth management business. The bank states the move reflects its strategic evolution and a focus on providing tailored solutions for clients. The identity was unveiled at an event held at The Ritz-Carlton in Bahrain.

stories.title: Luminous Power Technologies unveils new identity to expand energy portfolio
stories.summary: Luminous Power Technologies has introduced a new logo and the tagline “Har Soch Mein Power.” The company is transitioning from an inverter and battery manufacturer into a broader consumer energy solutions business. The move is built on 38 years of experience in Indian households.

stories.title: Product design teams split on AI adoption
stories.summary: Product design teams are currently divided on how to integrate AI, according to speakers at the PUSH UX conference. Some teams are cautiously experimenting with AI within existing frameworks, while others have integrated it into daily workflows. The split reflects how teams organize their work.

stories.title: MacOS 27.3 adds new disk access controls for AI agents
stories.summary: Apple is updating macOS 27.3 to require more deliberate user action for apps requesting full disk access. The change targets autonomous agents that routinely ask for control over the entire machine. Apple has not yet confirmed a release date for the update.

stories.title: Adobe Walks A Tightrope Between Traditional Creators, AI Embrace - Forbes
Comparing AI video generation tools for creators
stories.summary: AI video platforms including Adobe Firefly, Runway, and Kling AI are increasingly used by content creators and marketers. Choosing between them involves evaluating specific workflows, pricing, and licensing terms. Demos often fail to capture how these tools perform in practice for different creative goals.

stories.title: Adobe faces open-source alternatives at MAX 2026
stories.summary: Adobe's annual conference featured a focus on AI, even as open-source alternatives to its Creative Cloud suite gain traction. One project, ArtCraft, provides free tools built using Claude Code. The creative industry is changing how its own software is built.

stories.title: Google Pics adds object editing and text translation
stories.summary: Google Pics now allows users to edit individual objects within images and translate text while preserving original fonts and layouts. The tool supports 29 languages and enables simultaneous collaboration on a single canvas. The system treats image elements as independent layers for easier adjustment.

stories.title: Adobe introduces AI assistant for Premiere
stories.summary: Adobe has announced a new AI assistant for its Premiere video editing software. AI was the primary theme at the company's annual MAX conference for the third consecutive year. The assistant aims to streamline workflows through new features and panels.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude DATA
stories.summary: Anthropic has released Claude DATA, a guide for users to master dashboard creation and data visualization within Claude Code. The resource is aimed at developers and designers looking to integrate data handling into their workflows.

stories.title: Adobe Firefly faces new competition
stories.summary: Adobe has long marketed Firefly as commercially safe because it uses licensed and public-domain data. While the company pushed for content labeling to distinguish itself from rivals, it now faces competition from other models. Artists continue to question the ownership of machine-generated work.

stories.title: Adobe promotes Firefly AI assistant for content creators
stories.summary: Adobe is positioning its Firefly AI assistant as a tool to reduce the time required for video production. The company claims the assistant makes the creation process more frictionless. Users can currently access the tool through various plan options.

stories.title: Claude adds interactive HTML-in-Canvas capabilities
stories.summary: Claude can now embed interactive HTML elements like buttons and text into canvas graphics. The feature allows for web elements to exist within 3D effects while remaining selectable and clickable. Anthropic developer Felix Rieseberg says the tool can build complex, interactive web pages.

stories.title: Adobe and Google DeepMind explore near-real-time AI edits
stories.summary: Adobe and Google DeepMind are collaborating on AI-powered tools for Photoshop. The companies are exploring a customized image model that could allow users to make edits in near real time using prompts. No specific release date for these features has been announced.

stories.title: The role of design in the age of AI
stories.summary: The rise of AI tools is prompting questions about the necessity of paying for traditional design software. The shift suggests that design itself may be the answer to the current AI-driven landscape.

stories.title: A guide for UI edge cases
stories.summary: This reference guide offers methods for catching UI edge cases before they reach production. It covers how to test, detect, and design fixes for layout and interaction issues. The guide includes examples to illustrate how designers might handle scenarios that occur when things do not go as planned.

stories.title: Six rules for data visualization
stories.summary: Organizations collect vast amounts of data, yet struggle to turn those figures into clear insights. This guide outlines six rules for creating dashboards that move beyond simple data collection to answer fundamental questions. It aims to help designers transform complex information into meaningful and actionable visual formats.

stories.title: 1Password uses Figma Make to design for trust
stories.summary: 1Password uses Figma Make to maintain consistency across its security products. The company says its design focus is on trust and certainty, ensuring that autofill and AI agent credential approvals feel like the 1Password experience. Security products apparently require a specific feeling to be considered good UX.

stories.title: Monotype Launches Brand Font Panel for Adobe Creative Apps - StreetInsider
Staggering animations with CSS
stories.summary: A recent article explores how to stagger CSS scrolling animations using emergent features and complex math. The author describes the technique as a huge formula that can look intimidating. One contributor called the approach CSS on drugs, which may or may not be related to his current recovery.

stories.title: Comparing UI testing tools in 2026
stories.summary: Modern frontend teams rarely rely on a single tool for UI testing. Effective setups now involve a test runner layer to monitor behavior and a review platform to route visual changes for sign-off. The best tool is defined by whatever specific layout or accessibility issues a team needs.

stories.title: The Mad Brains launches AI-powered UX audits
stories.summary: The Mad Brains has introduced AI-powered UX audit services to help businesses identify why visitors leave without converting. The service combines AI analysis with human review to create a prioritized plan for fixes. Analytics show where users drop off, but rarely explain why they choose to leave.

stories.title: A new web design tool focuses on craft
stories.summary: A new web design tool has launched with a stated focus on craft rather than automation. The creator argues that design conversations have shifted too far toward technology and away from the precision of 20th-century graphic design. The tool is currently available for a live demo.

stories.title: Designers and the art of choice
stories.summary: A weekly design resource notes that AI removes the art from design by automating the thousands of small choices that define a creative work. The author summarizes the current state of AI as a vending machine with ambitions, a description that has reportedly received eye rolls at dinner parties.

stories.title: Designing robots for interaction
stories.summary: A recent entry in the UX Collective explores the intersection of kawaii culture, embarrassment, and the design of robots. The piece focuses on how to design machines that are intended to hand items to people rather than simply perform tasks. The robots are apparently designed to be polite.

stories.title: India's First Museum To Win The Red Dot 'Best Of The Best' Is Built Around Ancient Ruins - NDTV
Vadnagar Museum wins Red Dot award
stories.summary: The Anant Anadi Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum in Gujarat has received the Red Dot Best of the Best Award 2026 in Berlin. It is the first museum in India to achieve this recognition. Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghvi announced the win on social media earlier this week.

stories.title: Vadnagar museum receives global design honor
stories.summary: The Anant Anadi Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum has been awarded Germany's Red Dot Best of the Best Award 2026. The museum, which opened in January 2025, covers 12,500 square metres and cost approximately 298 crore rupees to develop. It is the first Indian museum to receive this award.

stories.title: Rebranding Kashmir's industries
stories.summary: Kashmir's global identity is reportedly losing ground as its traditional industries fail to keep pace with changing markets. Reviving the brand requires a coordinated economic strategy to turn handicrafts into competitive assets. The industry currently faces challenges from imitation products and shifting consumer preferences in the global market.

stories.title: NID students win design contest
stories.summary: Students from NID Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar secured the first and second runner-up spots at the Maruti Suzuki DesignXathon 2026. The winning concepts focused on adaptable vehicles designed for both people and pets. The top three participants were awarded cash prizes for their automotive design work.

stories.title: Vadnagar museum wins second international honor
stories.summary: The Anant Anadi Vadnagar museum has won the Red Dot Best of the Best Design Award 2026 in Berlin. This follows a Platinum A Design Award in Italy received two months ago. The museum displays over 6,000 excavated artifacts and is the first in India to win this honor.

stories.title: NID students earn design studio opportunities
stories.summary: Students from NID Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar took the top runner-up spots at the Maruti Suzuki DesignXathon 2026. The contest challenged participants to design a vehicle for Gen Z and Gen Alpha to own in 2036. Winners will receive six-month opportunities at the company's India Design Studio.

stories.title: Vadnagar museum is first in India to win Red Dot
stories.summary: The Anant Anadi Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum has won the Red Dot Best of the Best Award 2026. Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel stated the win places the town's archaeological heritage on the global design map. The museum features over 5,000 artifacts from 2,500 years of human habitation.

stories.summary: Gujarat’s Anant Anadi Vadnagar Archaeological Experiential Museum has won the Red Dot: Best of the Best Award 2026 in Berlin. The museum combines archaeological remains, thousands of artefacts, and immersive exhibition design to present the history of Vadnagar. The award provides fresh international recognition for its exhibition design.

stories.title: GOAT Robotics grows from rented apartment to international player
stories.summary: Engineering graduates from Coimbatore have grown GOAT Robotics from a rented apartment startup into a business with over Rs 8 crore in turnover. The company, which initially focused on hotel robots, now provides industrial automation services internationally and spends Rs 40 lakh monthly on salaries alone.

stories.title: Fermat raises $8 million to expand AI fashion platform
stories.summary: Barcelona-based Fermat has raised $8 million in seed funding to expand its AI platform from a design tool to full garment production. The company, which launched in 2022, offers a tool that turns designs into factory-ready specifications. It is currently used by more than 350 customers.

stories.summary: Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million (approximately Rs 215 crore) in seed funding to develop artificial intelligence (AI)-powered image sensors, as it looks to advance its chip technology and expand into international markets. Founded in late 2021, the company is developing programmable image sensors that integrate image capture,

stories.title: NovaSilicon raises ~$15M Pre-A+ to automate chip design - Dealroom
Cybersecurity startup Corma reaches $1 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Corma has raised $125 million at a $1 billion valuation, three months after launching its product. The company provides AI models and agents for defense. Interest in the startup increased following critical security flaws found in PHP and Node.js on October 21.

stories.title: Tiberius Aerospace reaches unicorn status with $85 million round
stories.summary: Munitions startup Tiberius Aerospace has raised $85 million at a $1 billion valuation. The company uses AI to design missiles and artillery, then works with third parties to manufacture the products. Its CEO describes the business model as following the Apple playbook.

Dreamteam Bags $53 Mn To Disrupt The CRM Space With AI
stories.summary: AI-native customer relationship management (CRM) platform Dreamteam, cofounded by former Freshworks executives, has emerged out of stealth mode. stories.title: Dreamteam raises $53 million for AI CRM platform
stories.summary: AI-native customer relationship management startup Dreamteam has raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel, and Premji Invest. Founded in 2025 by former Freshworks executives, the company is building a platform intended to understand customer context and execute tasks using AI coworkers.

stories.title: Numa raises $45 million for dealership AI
stories.summary: Oakland-based Numa has raised $45 million to build an AI operating system for car dealerships. The platform connects to existing software to handle customer service, appointment booking, and warranty paperwork. The startup aims to help dealerships manage workflows by automating routine tasks.

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million for AI image sensors
stories.summary: Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop programmable image sensors that integrate AI capabilities onto a single chip. The New Delhi-based company has secured design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon, with commercial production targeted for 2027.

stories.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million in Seed Funding to Develop AI-Powered Image Sensors - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million (approximately Rs 215 crore) in seed funding to advance the development of next-generation artificial intelligence-enabled image sensors for global markets. The New Delhi-based company plans to begin initial commercial production in 2027 and is exploring opportunities in the US and other

stories.summary: Google's Yi Xiang on how to build a design career across global borders The senior UX designer reveals the lessons that moving between different cultures has taught him. stories.title: Canva announces first mass layoff in 13-year history
stories.summary: Canva is eliminating 1,271 jobs, representing 22 percent of its workforce. CEO Melanie Perkins described the move as the company’s hardest moment. The cuts follow an August 2025 stock sale that valued the design-software company at $42 billion, despite generating $3.5 billion in revenue that year.

stories.title: Apple appoints new head of Apple Pay and Wallet
stories.summary: Apple lifer Corey Fugman will replace Jennifer Bailey as the head of the Apple Pay and Wallet division. Bailey, who led the division since its 2014 launch, is retiring. The company previously stated it would announce a successor before the end of October. October has concluded.

stories.title: Crunchyroll offers anime news updates
Shigeru Miyamoto to receive inaugural Legend Award
stories.summary: The Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences will present Shigeru Miyamoto with its new Legend Award at the 30th DICE Awards. The honor recognizes an icon whose vision redefines interactive entertainment and will be presented no more than once per decade. The award is currently occupied.

stories.title: The 4-Day Workweek Is More Attainable Than You Think,Here’s How to Land One - The Everygirl
Animation and game studios list 27 new job openings
stories.summary: Electronic Arts, Blizzard Entertainment and Pocketpair are each hiring for five roles, while Netflix Animation Studios has four openings. The list includes positions at Rodeo FX, Framestore and Industrial Light and Magic. The roundup covers roles ranging from senior leadership to entry-level positions.
